prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: The density-weight multiplicative update band `[LOWER_PCOF, UPPER_PCOF]` and its HPWL-ratio exponent control how fast density pressure ramps; widening the lower bound so the weight can also *decrease* when HPWL worsens (currently it is clamped to a narrow band that mostly grows) will let the placer spend more iterations on wirelength/timing before density dominates, giving rsz more slack headroom on moderately-critical nets (TNS).
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.457 robust(mean-std)=+0.084 min_case=+0.083 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.083 dWNS=+5.9% dTNS=+10.0% overflow~117
  bp-ng45: score=+0.244 dWNS=+15.3% dTNS=+30.5% overflow~140
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.129 dWNS=+9.0% dTNS=+15.7% overflow~116
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: all three cases improved, with dTNS gains of +10.0%, +30.5%, and +15.7% and dWNS gains of +5.9%, +15.3%, and +9.0%, consistent with the proposed mechanism—allowing the density weight to decrease when HPWL worsens lets the placer prioritize wirelength/timing longer, giving rsz more slack headroom on critical nets. Overflow (~116–140) stayed moderate, so gains aren't from density collapse. Next step: sweep the widened lower bound (e.g., 0.5×, 0.25× current LOWER_PCOF) and the HPWL-ratio exponent across seeds to confirm robustness and find the best trade-off before adopting.
